messages.subject: Image not uploading
parts:
I am having a problem getting images to load once I have deployed my application.

I am using renderImage() that renders an image conditional on some input. The code I use to call the image is:

return(list(src = "~/www/green light.jpg",align="center",width=200,height=400))

It works when I run the application locally but when I deploy the application to the shiny server I am no longer able to see the image. Is there something I need to include for in my code so that when I deploy the application it uploads the local image files as well?

Thanks!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Image not uploading
parts:
It looks like you are loading an image that is in your account.  You should either place that image somewhere on the web that is accessible or include it in the same directory as your application and have a relative path to it.

hth
